gaps.lead: You can't park here — it's forbidden.
gaps.explanation: mustn't = it is forbidden (not: don't have to).

gaps.lead: You can borrow the car as long as you drive carefully.
gaps.sentence: You can borrow the car ___ carefully.
gaps.explanation: provided (that) introduces the condition: provided you drive carefully.

gaps.lead: 'Have you seen my keys anywhere?' he asked us.
gaps.sentence: He asked us ___ seen his keys anywhere.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + had + participle: whether we had seen.

gaps.lead: I'd love to be on a beach now.
gaps.explanation: wish + past (subjunctive were): I wish I were. 'was' is informal — only 'were' fits the keyword.

gaps.lead: The tickets were so expensive that we didn't buy any.
gaps.sentence: They were ___ that we didn't buy any.
gaps.explanation: so expensive (tickets) → such expensive tickets (no article with plural).

gaps.lead: I'm sure he isn't in Spain — he was here this morning.
gaps.sentence: He ___ in Spain — he was here this morning.
gaps.explanation: can't be = certainty that something is impossible (present).
